dedupe_keys.name: building fault detection and diagnostics benchmark data

description: This Figshare item publishes fault-labelled HVAC operating time series for evaluating building fault detection and diagnostics methods. The six CSV files combine simulated and experimental air-handling or rooftop-unit cases, with minute-scale variables and a final fault indicator. A separate inventory PDF describes system configuration and provenance. The series can train or test diagnostic components before they are used in building digital twins or maintenance simulations. They cover selected systems and fault severities, not every fault mode or a representative building population. Some cases use Modelica and other simulation tools, so measured and synthetic channels should be distinguished. Figshare states CC0 for the data item; an Open Energy Data Initiative page provides a related access route. I read both own pages and the descriptor without downloading files or running a detector. The existing Modelica Buildings Library record is related model context, not coverage of these fault cases.
